content: Better Bedrock is arguably the most popular texture pack client available. It originally started off as "Utility Pack" by Ambro (as can be seen in the screenshot), but was eventually released as Better Bedrock. The amount of drama that this client has been through is crazy, with the most notable controversy being the first mod menu that could be used on PC. After Ambro and/or TLGM figured out how to do it, the method quickly spread, resulting in a race to see who could release the first client with a mod menu for both PC and mobile. Luconia Client won the race by releasing in a rough state but with a working mod menu. Nonetheless, the client has remained popular over the years, rarely releasing new versions every now and then. These days, Better Bedrock also has a website where you can download other packs and an external PC client. The biggest downside for me is the switch from its original style to oreUI, which makes it look kind of boring now. Also, for some reason, with each patch, more features are removed than added, which I find funny.
Really obvious skid of Glacier Client.

Formerly known as Orion Client. For the most part, a Bedezu Client skid.

Concepts for V2, in the screenshots.

After Luconia, the main developer, Velan, focused on his YouTube channel. After some time, he returned to pack development and created Azelux under his new name, Velan. The Azelux Client is the spiritual successor of the Luconia Client. It is the first client to offer an easy way to save your configuration and cosmetics. While V1 was designed to resemble the Lunar Client, Azelux was originally intended to resemble the Feather Client, as can be seen in the alpha versions. To "perfect" this client, Velan enlisted the help of other developers. lliT is a lead developer and owner, and Pepe helped with several modules. The Azelux codebase is just a mix of the Glacier and Cobalt clients, with some additions. After much anticipation for V1, the release was rather disappointing, as the game crashed on low-end devices. No fix has ever been released for this issue, with Velan saying, "Just wait for v2." As the spiritual successor of Luconia, V2 was never released, with most of the developers quitting after V1. This left only Velan on the team, who is rarely active nowadays, dooming another anticipated release to never see the light of day.

 In the screenshots, you can see some concepts.

Curation Client was probably the first client ever created by Lumo/Velan, who was still known as Cxrdion at the time. Although it was mainly a buggy combination of multiple packs, it already set the trend for cosmetics. For unknown reasons, he quit the Cxrdion account and created the Lumo/Velan account, going on to create Luconia and Azelux later on.

The screenshots show an old vote held by Cxrdion (account now named ChapterIII, Discord ID: velisa_1) in 2022 regarding the new logo for the client, which includes unused concepts for the start screen.

As Pepe said, 'Glacier client before glacier'. Project Light was the predecessor to Glacier Client, although it actually came after Glacier Client v3. Back then, Glacier still wasn't popular. There were four versions before it was changed into Glacier Client sometime in 2024. Project Light came about by combining several smaller client creators into one big team consisting of Pepe (who now works on Glacier Client), Flexyus (who is barely active), Kyra (who has left) and mclocked (who now produces phonk music). You can still find relics of that time on the current Glacier Client Discord server.

Fun fact: Papier (the Glacier Discord owner) bought the Discord from Zivflix (the ZF Client owner) for $10.

content: Luconia was first named "Curation Client" by Cxrdion (who is actually Lumo using a different name). Then, Cxrdion created a new Discord account (the Lumo account), gave the ownership of the Curation Discord server to his new account, and rebranded it to Luconia, giving it a fresh start. Luconia Client was one of the most popular clients ever made. It was the first one to release a working mod menu for PCs and mobile devices. A lot of people were upset about it because the client community was at its best. Some of the problems include stolen code and the Discord moderator "Blue Boy". People were really looking forward to Luconia v2, but it never came out. The person who made it, Lumo, stopped working on it and started a new channel on YouTube called "Flxshed." The new owner, Nyami, never really managed to create version 2, but they did create a beta DLL for Luconia. They promised a better version, which of course never happened or is still in the works.

content: This is Chyves's last project before Selaura client. This one was actually released.

Chyves' Bedrock+ was one of the first clients to use the oreUI style. Although a full version was never released, we still obtained some beta leaks. At one point during development, Bedrock+ (or Chyves) attempted to collaborate with Better Bedrock in an attempt to optimise its code, although nothing official ever came of it. Towards the end of its lifespan, the texture pack turned into a DLL client for Windows, causing the project to eventually shift into Selaura.

The Bedezu Client was the first to feature a mod menu in Minecraft Bedrock Edition (MCBE) texture packs, which was pretty revolutionary back in the day. It was also the first client to recreate the UI of Lunar Client on Bedrock. It was originally made by Bedezu, HJN and Chixuty. Then Chixuty started making his own client, Turtle Client (later renamed Asteroid Client), but that's not important right now. Work on Bedezu then continued with Bedezu and HJN. Later on, Lumo and Pepe joined as well — a name you'll hear a lot. Lumo left quickly, then HJN left to work on his own project. Only Bedezu and Pepe remained, and they created the final versions, which were based on Project Light by Pepe. lliT joined the team during the later development of the final versions, but no official release ever came of it, with the latest beta being Bedezu Client 0.0.7. As of 2026, Bedezu has been discontinued, but it has earned its place in the history of MCBE pack clients.

Asteroid Client, made by Chixuty, is one of the most famous clients and is usually a top 5 contender in PatarHD's MCBE texture pack client rankings. Asteroid, Bedezu, and CM Client are all based on the same base VDX Java UI by CrisXolt, and Chixuty had a part in two of them (Asteroid and Bedezu). Asteroid is the successor to Turtle Client by Bari. Chixuty is the current owner/developer, along with other collaborators. He also faked his death for no reason, and recently changed his Discord name to Adolf Hitler.

content: Chyves, formerly known as JudahRR, is a well-known member of the community and the creator of a shit ton packs and other projects. These include the Amethyst, Pétite Client, Bedrock+ and Selaura client, as well as countless other contributions to other clients and projects.

Lumo is probably one of the most well-known members of the client community, for better or worse. He is famously known for creating Luconia Client, as well as Curation and Azelux Client. He is also known for not handling criticism well, trying to create an official Lunar Client port for Bedrock, being unable to create a v2 for any of his newer clients, and, of course, always arguing with the creator of Better Bedrock, Ambro. After Curation, he switched accounts (from Cxrdion to Lumo), took a break, and started a fairly successful YouTube channel under the name Flxshed. He would later return to client development in 2025. His comeback was rather successful, and Azelux gathered a large fanbase under his new name, Velan. Recently, he has become inactive again, barely active on Discord and not posting on YouTube.
